scope_note: This record independently re-checks citation locators (path + qualified name + line range) and whether evidence selectors point at the cited raw text. It covers citation/code conformance ONLY. It is NOT a semantic review, NOT a product/behavior acceptance, and NOT a model run. No production model was invoked; /api/review/code/sync and the validator were not executed here; tests were not run. Seed rows remain seed=true, verified_by_agent=false. This file is intentionally not imported by the understanding narrative loader; it lives apart from *.seed.json.
method: Read each *.seed.json, then opened the cited source file at the on-disk tree and located the declared symbol by grep/Read. Verified (a) the symbol exists at the claimed file and kind, (b) the claimed line range brackets the declaration, (c) each rule-type evidence selector actually points at the file named by its `ref` and quotes that raw text.
